machine: Apple M1 Pro, CPU, 4 threads, nice 15
summary: the five domains of the topic's samples tokenized with GPT-2's tokenizer (train tokens: web 2.28M, wiki 9.36M, code 2.74M, math 2.82M, papers 0.27M); one proxy (793,344 non-embedding parameters, 7,259,008 with the tied 50,257-token embedding) trained 60 steps of 16 x 256 tokens on uniform weights: held-out loss per domain (nats) web 7.54, wiki 8.02, code 5.27, math 7.42, papers 8.19, all already below the uniform-guess level of ln 50,257 = 10.82; about 6,438 tokens/s (rough, shared machine, 4 threads at low priority). The sweep, DoReMi and fetch commands were also run for 2, 30 and tiny sizes to check they work; those numbers mean nothing yet.
estimates_html: Estimates (CPU throughput measured; GPU speed assumed 10 to 20 times faster, not measured here): pools 10 to 20 min (network); sweep of 48 runs x 16.4M tokens = 786M tokens, 1.7 to 3.4 h; three anchor mixtures, 0.1 to 0.2 h; DoReMi reference and proxy, 0.1 to 0.2 h; rank check, two 10.6M-non-embedding models on 98M tokens each, 2 to 3.5 h. Total about 4 to 7 hours on the GPU queue.
